notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Blood Pet trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Blood Pet, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
